summary: The implementation successfully covers all 10 requirements (REQ-71 through REQ-80). The backend correctly extends the Message type with messageType variants (text, groceryList, socialMediaLink) and optional fields for groceryItems and socialMediaUrl. The frontend adds comprehensive UI for message type selection, grocery list composition with add/remove functionality, social media link input with URL validation, and enhanced message rendering with distinct visual styles for each message type. A migration module ensures backward compatibility with existing text messages.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) that transforms old messages to new message structure
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not specify implementing a migration strategy or module. While the migration maintains compatibility (which is mentioned as a constraint), the creation of a separate migration.mo file and the migration logic itself was not requested.
